title: The Locks
summary: The Cult's boat ties up at the Canal Locks, and the eel-men say somebody is preaching there. Dace would like to know what he's preaching, and what's listening.

steps.journal: Go into the Canal Locks, up the canal from Saltmere. Someone is preaching on the first floor, by the way in. Hear him out.
The lock-men in the Sluice have stopped lying still. Go down to the Locks' second floor and hold the Sluice, the hall at the far end, for five waves.

ready: The Sluice is quiet again. Tell Dace Pike, at the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
done: You told Dace about the man in the plain coat. He wrote it down, then wrote 'no name' next to it, then underlined that.
